method: Manual review of live PR metadata, exact-head workflow runs and job logs, combined statuses, formal review records, live main refs, the R/Julia meta_V source and tests, exact-path ownership preflight and granted lease, one fixed-seed R accessor fit, the #1237 exact-head Julia 1.10.10 focused test, and the #1659 exact-head R stored-fixture test, each with a checksum-bound log; then structure, closeout, prose, JSON, and diff checks. The #1240 provenance follow-up also checked the current-contrib source archive SHA-256, its DESCRIPTION and NEWS, the local v0.7.0 release tag, the interrupted isolated install, and the observed Totoro load; no owner-held fixture or PR was edited.
coverage: Whole report by continuity from v36; added exact-head #1237 Julia and #1659 R focused test results and retained the #1659 raw output in-repository while preserving the limits on full-suite, live-bridge, review, parity, and interval-calibration claims. Added the source-provenance discrepancy for #1240 and kept the exact generating build unresolved.
score_reason: The report uses exact files, SHAs, run IDs, and explicit limits. Some technical sentences are dense, but the PR status is separated into short bullets.
confidence_reason: Current GitHub PR metadata, workflow/job logs, combined statuses, review records, live git ls-remote refs, exact-path lane preflight/lease, the Totoro source SHA/runtime/test result/clean checkout/raw-log checksum, and the isolated R worktree SHA/runtime/test result/raw-log checksum were checked. No current-pair parity or interval calibration is inferred. The #1240 follow-up verified the downloaded source archive checksum and its package metadata, but did not install it or claim it matches the R 4.3.3 fixture generator.

science_gate_reason: This report records a documentation reconciliation, not a new scientific result.
facts_gate_reason: Exact heads, bases, review/check conclusions, and #1233/#1228 patch content were checked live. Both focused exact-head test logs were checked and their runtimes and skip boundaries are recorded; the report does not turn them into current-pair parity, full-suite, or interval-calibration claims. The current-contrib archive and local release tag both identify an unaccepted/not-submitted 0.7.0 candidate; the report does not treat either as the exact fixture-generating build.
references_gate_reason: The linked PRs and workflow runs refer to the exact items checked during this refresh; no unsupported external scientific references were added. The report links the exact source archive URL and records its checksum; no literature claims were added.
calibration_status: No style controls were used; this is an uncalibrated editorial judgment.
